tytul: Eggplant strips in olive oil with garlic and mint: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for eggplant strips kept in olive oil with garlic and mint (Italian melanzane sott'olio).

ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard.

The acidification method for homemade garlic and herb oils was developed only for garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary; it does not cover other vegetables or herbs, such as peppers or mushrooms. Adding garlic does not bring eggplant under this method.

akapity: Peppers, garlic, mushrooms and eggplant have been involved in botulism outbreaks from vegetables and herbs in oil, mostly homemade products.
In Italy in 1993, two type B botulism outbreaks were linked to commercially prepared roasted eggplant in oil.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for eggplant in oil from a checked source.
